problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: This is the book of my brother.
mistakes.right: This is my brother's book.
mistakes.why: Sở hữu của người dùng 's, không dùng cấu trúc of kiểu dịch từ tiếng Việt.

mistakes.wrong: Its a nice car.
mistakes.right: It's a nice car.
mistakes.why: It's = it is; ITS (không phẩy) mới là tính từ sở hữu.

mistakes.wrong: This bag is my.
mistakes.right: This bag is mine.
mistakes.why: Cuối câu dùng đại từ sở hữu (mine), không dùng tính từ sở hữu (my).

mistakes.wrong: Their going home now.
mistakes.right: They're going home now.
mistakes.why: They're = they are; their là tính từ sở hữu — hai từ khác nghĩa.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: She has a car red.
mistakes.right: She has a red car.
mistakes.why: Tính từ đứng TRƯỚC danh từ trong tiếng Anh (ngược tiếng Việt).

mistakes.wrong: They are happys.
mistakes.right: They are happy.
mistakes.why: Tính từ không chia số nhiều — không thêm -s.

mistakes.wrong: He is more tall than me.
mistakes.right: He is taller than me.
mistakes.why: Tính từ ngắn 1 âm tiết thêm -er, không dùng more.

mistakes.wrong: It is a interesting book.
mistakes.right: It is an interesting book.
mistakes.why: Trước nguyên âm (i) dùng AN, không dùng a.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: There are a book on the table.
mistakes.right: There is a book on the table.
mistakes.why: Danh từ số ít (a book) đi với THERE IS.

mistakes.wrong: There is three chairs here.
mistakes.right: There are three chairs here.
mistakes.why: Danh từ số nhiều (three chairs) đi với THERE ARE.

mistakes.wrong: It is a park near my house.
mistakes.right: There is a park near my house.
mistakes.why: Giới thiệu sự tồn tại lần đầu dùng THERE, không dùng it.

mistakes.wrong: Have many people in the room.
mistakes.right: There are many people in the room.
mistakes.why: Không dịch "có" thành have — dùng there are.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: Where you are from?
mistakes.right: Where are you from?
mistakes.why: Câu hỏi đảo trợ động từ/be lên trước chủ ngữ.

mistakes.wrong: What you do yesterday?
mistakes.right: What did you do yesterday?
mistakes.why: Câu hỏi quá khứ cần trợ động từ DID + động từ nguyên thể.

mistakes.wrong: Who did phone you?
mistakes.right: Who phoned you?
mistakes.why: Khi từ để hỏi là chủ ngữ, không dùng did.

mistakes.wrong: How much you pay?
mistakes.right: How much did you pay?
mistakes.why: Thiếu trợ động từ did trong câu hỏi quá khứ.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I go always to school by bike.
mistakes.right: I always go to school by bike.
mistakes.why: Trạng từ tần suất đứng TRƯỚC động từ thường.

mistakes.wrong: She always is late.
mistakes.right: She is always late.
mistakes.why: Với động từ be, trạng từ tần suất đứng SAU be.

mistakes.wrong: He usual watches TV.
mistakes.right: He usually watches TV.
mistakes.why: Dùng trạng từ (usually), không dùng tính từ (usual).

mistakes.wrong: Never I eat meat.
mistakes.right: I never eat meat.
mistakes.why: Never đứng giữa câu, trước động từ thường — không mở đầu câu (trừ đảo ngữ trang trọng).

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: The cat is in the table.
mistakes.right: The cat is on the table.
mistakes.why: Trên bề mặt phẳng dùng ON, không dùng in.

mistakes.wrong: I live at Hanoi.
mistakes.right: I live in Hanoi.
mistakes.why: Thành phố/quốc gia dùng IN, không dùng at.

mistakes.wrong: She is standing in the bus stop.
mistakes.right: She is standing at the bus stop.
mistakes.why: Tại một điểm cụ thể dùng AT.

mistakes.wrong: The picture is in the wall.
mistakes.right: The picture is on the wall.
mistakes.why: Treo trên bề mặt tường dùng ON.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I can to swim.
mistakes.right: I can swim.
mistakes.why: Sau can là động từ nguyên thể KHÔNG to.

mistakes.wrong: She cans drive.
mistakes.right: She can drive.
mistakes.why: Can là modal — không chia -s theo ngôi.

mistakes.wrong: He can't to come.
mistakes.right: He can't come.
mistakes.why: Sau can't cũng là động từ nguyên thể không to.

mistakes.wrong: The fire spread, but everybody could escape.
mistakes.right: The fire spread, but everybody was able to escape.
mistakes.why: Thành công trong tình huống cụ thể quá khứ dùng was able to, không dùng could.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I have many money.
mistakes.right: I have a lot of money.
mistakes.why: Money không đếm được — không đi với many; dùng a lot of.

mistakes.wrong: There are much cars.
mistakes.right: There are many cars.
mistakes.why: Cars đếm được số nhiều dùng many, không dùng much.

mistakes.wrong: I don't have some time.
mistakes.right: I don't have any time.
mistakes.why: Câu phủ định dùng ANY, không dùng some.

mistakes.wrong: She has few money.
mistakes.right: She has little money.
mistakes.why: Money không đếm được dùng little, không dùng few.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: She is more tall than him.
mistakes.right: She is taller than him.
mistakes.why: Tính từ ngắn thêm -er, không dùng more.

mistakes.wrong: This is the most big house.
mistakes.right: This is the biggest house.
mistakes.why: Tính từ ngắn thêm -est, không dùng most.

mistakes.wrong: He is more clever than me.
mistakes.right: He is cleverer than me.
mistakes.why: Tính từ 2 âm tiết kết thúc bằng -er/-y thường thêm -er.

mistakes.wrong: That is the most cheapest one.
mistakes.right: That is the cheapest one.
mistakes.why: Không ghép most + -est (double superlative).

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: Can I to use your phone?
mistakes.right: Can I use your phone?
mistakes.why: Sau can là động từ nguyên thể không to.

mistakes.wrong: May I borrowing your pen?
mistakes.right: May I borrow your pen?
mistakes.why: Sau may là động từ nguyên thể, không phải V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: He said we might wait here.
mistakes.right: He said we could wait here.
mistakes.why: Trong câu tường thuật, may (xin phép) lùi thành could.

mistakes.wrong: You mustn't go, it's optional.
mistakes.right: You don't have to go, it's optional.
mistakes.why: Mustn't = cấm; don't have to = không cần — không nhầm.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I must to finish this today.
mistakes.right: I must finish this today.
mistakes.why: Sau must là động từ nguyên thể không to.

mistakes.wrong: Yesterday I must walk home.
mistakes.right: Yesterday I had to walk home.
mistakes.why: Nghĩa vụ quá khứ dùng had to — must không có dạng quá khứ.

mistakes.wrong: You mustn't come, it's not necessary.
mistakes.right: You don't have to come, it's not necessary.
mistakes.why: Không bắt buộc dùng don't have to; mustn't nghĩa là CẤM.

mistakes.wrong: She must wears a uniform.
mistakes.right: She must wear a uniform.
mistakes.why: Sau must, động từ về nguyên thể — không chia -s.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: You should to see a doctor.
mistakes.right: You should see a doctor.
mistakes.why: Sau should là động từ nguyên thể không to.

mistakes.wrong: He shoulds study harder.
mistakes.right: He should study harder.
mistakes.why: Should là modal — không chia -s.

mistakes.wrong: You had better to go now.
mistakes.right: You had better go now.
mistakes.why: Sau had better là động từ nguyên thể không to.

mistakes.wrong: I think everybody had better learn English.
mistakes.right: I think everybody should learn English.
mistakes.why: Lời khuyên chung dùng should; had better chỉ cho tình huống cụ thể.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain, I will stay home.
mistakes.right: If it rains, I will stay home.
mistakes.why: Mệnh đề if không dùng will — dùng hiện tại đơn.

mistakes.wrong: If you heat ice, it melt.
mistakes.right: If you heat ice, it melts.
mistakes.why: Loại 0 dùng hiện tại đơn cả hai vế — ngôi 3 thêm -s.

mistakes.wrong: If I have time, I visit you.
mistakes.right: If I have time, I will visit you.
mistakes.why: Loại 1 vế kết quả cần WILL cho dự định tương lai.

mistakes.wrong: Unless you don't hurry, you will be late.
mistakes.right: Unless you hurry, you will be late.
mistakes.why: Unless đã mang nghĩa phủ định — không thêm don't.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I am learning English for five years.
mistakes.right: I have been learning English for five years.
mistakes.why: Quá trình kéo dài đến nay + for dùng present perfect continuous.

mistakes.wrong: She has been knowing him for years.
mistakes.right: She has known him for years.
mistakes.why: Know là động từ trạng thái — dùng present perfect đơn.

mistakes.wrong: He has been work all day.
mistakes.right: He has been working all day.
mistakes.why: Sau has been phải là V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: They have been played since morning.
mistakes.right: They have been playing since morning.
mistakes.why: Dạng tiếp diễn dùng V-ing, không phải quá khứ phân từ.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: When I arrived, the train already left.
mistakes.right: When I arrived, the train had already left.
mistakes.why: Việc xảy ra trước một mốc quá khứ dùng past perfect (had + P2).

mistakes.wrong: She had went home before I called.
mistakes.right: She had gone home before I called.
mistakes.why: Sau had dùng quá khứ phân từ (gone), không dùng quá khứ đơn.

mistakes.wrong: After he had ate, he slept.
mistakes.right: After he had eaten, he slept.
mistakes.why: P2 của eat là eaten, không phải ate.

mistakes.wrong: I had never see snow before that trip.
mistakes.right: I had never seen snow before that trip.
mistakes.why: P2 của see là seen sau had.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I use to play football when I was young.
mistakes.right: I used to play football when I was young.
mistakes.why: Khẳng định dùng USED to (có d).

mistakes.wrong: I didn't used to like coffee.
mistakes.right: I didn't use to like coffee.
mistakes.why: Sau didn't dùng USE to (bỏ d).

mistakes.wrong: She is used to get up early now.
mistakes.right: She is used to getting up early now.
mistakes.why: Be used to + V-ing (đã quen với việc gì).

mistakes.wrong: He used to smoking a lot.
mistakes.right: He used to smoke a lot.
mistakes.why: Used to + động từ nguyên thể (thói quen quá khứ).

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: At 8pm I will have dinner (đang ăn dở).
mistakes.right: At 8pm I will be having dinner.
mistakes.why: Hành động đang diễn ra tại mốc tương lai dùng will be + V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: This time tomorrow I will flying to Paris.
mistakes.right: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Paris.
mistakes.why: Thiếu BE trong cấu trúc will be + V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: While I will be waiting, I will read.
mistakes.right: While I am waiting, I will read.
mistakes.why: Mệnh đề thời gian (while) không dùng will.

mistakes.wrong: The meeting will be start at seven.
mistakes.right: The meeting will be starting at seven.
mistakes.why: Sau will be phải là V-ing, không phải nguyên thể.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: Because of he was late, he missed the bus.
mistakes.right: Because he was late, he missed the bus.
mistakes.why: Because of đi với danh từ; có mệnh đề dùng because.

mistakes.wrong: Although his tiredness, he kept working.
mistakes.right: Despite his tiredness, he kept working.
mistakes.why: Although đi với mệnh đề; trước danh từ dùng despite.

mistakes.wrong: Although it was late, but we continued.
mistakes.right: Although it was late, we continued.
mistakes.why: Không ghép đôi although...but trong một câu.

mistakes.wrong: I couldn't sleep despite I was tired.
mistakes.right: I couldn't sleep despite being tired.
mistakes.why: Despite là giới từ — theo sau là danh từ/V-ing, không phải mệnh đề.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I enjoy to read books.
mistakes.right: I enjoy reading books.
mistakes.why: Sau enjoy dùng V-ing, không dùng to-infinitive.

mistakes.wrong: She wants going home.
mistakes.right: She wants to go home.
mistakes.why: Sau want dùng to-infinitive, không dùng V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: He avoided to meet her.
mistakes.right: He avoided meeting her.
mistakes.why: Sau avoid dùng V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: They decided buying a house.
mistakes.right: They decided to buy a house.
mistakes.why: Sau decide dùng to-infinitive.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: The house was build in 1990.
mistakes.right: The house was built in 1990.
mistakes.why: Bị động dùng quá khứ phân từ (built), không dùng nguyên thể.

mistakes.wrong: English is speak here.
mistakes.right: English is spoken here.
mistakes.why: Sau is/are dùng P2 (spoken).

mistakes.wrong: The letter was wrote by Tom.
mistakes.right: The letter was written by Tom.
mistakes.why: P2 của write là written.

mistakes.wrong: This song was sang by her.
mistakes.right: This song was sung by her.
mistakes.why: P2 của sing là sung, không phải sang.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: He said he will come.
mistakes.right: He said he would come.
mistakes.why: Câu tường thuật quá khứ: will lùi thành would.

mistakes.wrong: She told that she was tired.
mistakes.right: She said that she was tired.
mistakes.why: Tell cần tân ngữ (told me); không tân ngữ dùng said.

mistakes.wrong: He asked where do I live.
mistakes.right: He asked where I lived.
mistakes.why: Câu hỏi tường thuật dùng trật tự câu kể, lùi thì.

mistakes.wrong: She said me she was busy.
mistakes.right: She told me she was busy.
mistakes.why: Có tân ngữ (me) dùng told, không dùng said me.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: The man which lives here is kind.
mistakes.right: The man who lives here is kind.
mistakes.why: Chỉ người dùng who, không dùng which.

mistakes.wrong: The book who I read was good.
mistakes.right: The book which I read was good.
mistakes.why: Chỉ vật dùng which/that, không dùng who.

mistakes.wrong: This is the house where I live in it.
mistakes.right: This is the house where I live.
mistakes.why: Where đã thay cho "in which" — không lặp giới từ/đại từ.

mistakes.wrong: The keys that we were looking for them are here.
mistakes.right: The keys that we were looking for are here.
mistakes.why: That đã làm tân ngữ — không lặp them thừa.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: If I was you, I would apologize.
mistakes.right: If I were you, I would apologize.
mistakes.why: Loại 2 dùng WERE cho mọi ngôi trong giả định.

mistakes.wrong: If I had money, I will buy a car.
mistakes.right: If I had money, I would buy a car.
mistakes.why: Loại 2 vế kết quả dùng would, không dùng will.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have time, I would help.
mistakes.right: If I had time, I would help.
mistakes.why: Mệnh đề if loại 2 dùng quá khứ đơn, không dùng would.

mistakes.wrong: If she studied, she will pass.
mistakes.right: If she studied, she would pass.
mistakes.why: Giả định hiện tại không thực: vế kết quả dùng would.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: If I had studied, I would passed.
mistakes.right: If I had studied, I would have passed.
mistakes.why: Loại 3 vế kết quả cần would HAVE + P2.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have known, I would have come.
mistakes.right: If I had known, I would have come.
mistakes.why: Mệnh đề if loại 3 dùng past perfect (had + P2), không dùng would have.

mistakes.wrong: If she had came earlier, she would have seen him.
mistakes.right: If she had come earlier, she would have seen him.
mistakes.why: P2 của come là come sau had.

mistakes.wrong: If they had left, they would catch the train.
mistakes.right: If they had left, they would have caught the train.
mistakes.why: Việc đã qua: vế kết quả loại 3 dùng would have + P2.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: He must to be tired.
mistakes.right: He must be tired.
mistakes.why: Sau must là động từ nguyên thể không to.

mistakes.wrong: She must has left already.
mistakes.right: She must have left already.
mistakes.why: Suy đoán quá khứ dùng must HAVE + P2 (have nguyên thể).

mistakes.wrong: It can't to be true.
mistakes.right: It can't be true.
mistakes.why: Sau can't là động từ nguyên thể không to.

mistakes.wrong: He can't saw me yesterday.
mistakes.right: He can't have seen me yesterday.
mistakes.why: Phủ định suy đoán quá khứ dùng can't have + P2.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: You are a student, are you?
mistakes.right: You are a student, aren't you?
mistakes.why: Câu khẳng định đi với tag PHỦ ĐỊNH.

mistakes.wrong: She can swim, can she?
mistakes.right: She can swim, can't she?
mistakes.why: Câu khẳng định phải đi với tag phủ định.

mistakes.wrong: You travel a lot, travel you?
mistakes.right: You travel a lot, don't you?
mistakes.why: Động từ thường hiện tại đơn dùng do/does trong tag.

mistakes.wrong: He won't be late, won't he?
mistakes.right: He won't be late, will he?
mistakes.why: Câu phủ định đi với tag KHẲNG ĐỊNH.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: Don't throw away it.
mistakes.right: Don't throw it away.
mistakes.why: Tân ngữ là đại từ (it) phải đứng GIỮA động từ và particle.

mistakes.wrong: Please turn on it.
mistakes.right: Please turn it on.
mistakes.why: Đại từ (it) đứng giữa turn và on.

mistakes.wrong: I gave up to smoke.
mistakes.right: I gave up smoking.
mistakes.why: Sau give up dùng V-ing, không dùng to-infinitive.

mistakes.wrong: Why did you run away of me?
mistakes.right: Why did you run away from me?
mistakes.why: Phrasal verb run away đi với from, không dùng of.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: She was tired because she worked all night.
mistakes.right: She was tired because she had been working all night.
mistakes.why: Quá trình kéo dài trước một mốc quá khứ dùng had been + V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: I had been knowing him for years.
mistakes.right: I had known him for years.
mistakes.why: Know là động từ trạng thái — dùng past perfect đơn.

mistakes.wrong: They had been play for hours.
mistakes.right: They had been playing for hours.
mistakes.why: Sau had been dùng V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: He had being working since noon.
mistakes.right: He had been working since noon.
mistakes.why: Cấu trúc là had BEEN + V-ing, không phải had being.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: By 2030 I will finish my degree.
mistakes.right: By 2030 I will have finished my degree.
mistakes.why: Việc sẽ xong TRƯỚC một mốc tương lai dùng will have + P2.

mistakes.wrong: By next month she will have finish it.
mistakes.right: By next month she will have finished it.
mistakes.why: Sau will have dùng quá khứ phân từ (finished).

mistakes.wrong: By 6pm they will had left.
mistakes.right: By 6pm they will have left.
mistakes.why: Cấu trúc là will HAVE + P2, không phải will had.

mistakes.wrong: By next year I will have work here for ten years.
mistakes.right: By next year I will have worked here for ten years.
mistakes.why: Sau will have dùng P2 (worked).

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: He said he will come.
mistakes.right: He said he would come.
mistakes.why: Nhìn tương lai từ quá khứ: will lùi thành would.

mistakes.wrong: I knew she is going to win.
mistakes.right: I knew she was going to win.
mistakes.why: Mệnh đề chính quá khứ kéo vế sau về was going to.

mistakes.wrong: We thought it will rain.
mistakes.right: We thought it would rain.
mistakes.why: Sau động từ quá khứ (thought), will → would.

mistakes.wrong: She promised she will help.
mistakes.right: She promised she would help.
mistakes.why: Tường thuật lời hứa quá khứ dùng would.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: If I had saved money, I will be rich now.
mistakes.right: If I had saved money, I would be rich now.
mistakes.why: Kết quả hiện tại của điều kiện quá khứ dùng would + V.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have won, I would be happy now.
mistakes.right: If I had won, I would be happy now.
mistakes.why: Mệnh đề if dùng past perfect, không dùng would have.

mistakes.wrong: If we didn't spend all our money, we could travel now.
mistakes.right: If we hadn't spent all our money, we could travel now.
mistakes.why: Điều kiện xảy ra trong quá khứ dùng past perfect dù kết quả ở hiện tại.

mistakes.wrong: If she was more careful yesterday, she wouldn't be hurt now.
mistakes.right: If she had been more careful yesterday, she wouldn't be hurt now.
mistakes.why: Điều kiện quá khứ (yesterday) dùng had been.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I wish I have more time.
mistakes.right: I wish I had more time.
mistakes.why: Wish về hiện tại không thực dùng quá khứ đơn.

mistakes.wrong: I wish I would be taller.
mistakes.right: I wish I were taller.
mistakes.why: Wish về chính mình dùng were, không dùng would.

mistakes.wrong: I wish I studied harder last year.
mistakes.right: I wish I had studied harder last year.
mistakes.why: Tiếc nuối quá khứ dùng past perfect (had + P2).

mistakes.wrong: I wish my English becomes better.
mistakes.right: I hope my English becomes better.
mistakes.why: Mong ước thực tế tương lai dùng hope, không dùng wish + hiện tại.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: You should came to the party.
mistakes.right: You should have come to the party.
mistakes.why: Tiếc nuối quá khứ dùng should have + P2.

mistakes.wrong: He must has left already.
mistakes.right: He must have left already.
mistakes.why: Suy đoán quá khứ dùng must have + P2 (have nguyên thể).

mistakes.wrong: She can't saw me.
mistakes.right: She can't have seen me.
mistakes.why: Phủ định suy đoán quá khứ dùng can't have + P2.

mistakes.wrong: I needn't to buy it.
mistakes.right: I needn't have bought it.
mistakes.why: Việc quá khứ không cần thiết dùng needn't have + P2.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I cut my hair yesterday (nhờ thợ).
mistakes.right: I had my hair cut yesterday.
mistakes.why: Nhờ người khác làm dùng have + vật + P2.

mistakes.wrong: How often do you have serviced your car?
mistakes.right: How often do you have your car serviced?
mistakes.why: Tân ngữ (your car) đứng TRƯỚC quá khứ phân từ.

mistakes.wrong: I got him repair the roof.
mistakes.right: I got him to repair the roof.
mistakes.why: Get + người + TO-infinitive.

mistakes.wrong: She made me to wait.
mistakes.right: She made me wait.
mistakes.why: Make + người + động từ nguyên thể KHÔNG to.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: She is said that she is rich.
mistakes.right: She is said to be rich.
mistakes.why: Personal passive dùng to-infinitive sau động từ tường thuật bị động.

mistakes.wrong: It is said she to be rich.
mistakes.right: It is said that she is rich.
mistakes.why: Impersonal passive dùng it + that + mệnh đề.

mistakes.wrong: The castle is thought to have built in 1500.
mistakes.right: The castle is thought to have been built in 1500.
mistakes.why: Hành động bị động quá khứ cần to have BEEN + P2.

mistakes.wrong: He is believed be innocent.
mistakes.right: He is believed to be innocent.
mistakes.why: Cần TO trước động từ trong personal passive.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: Anna told me about her job that she enjoys.
mistakes.right: Anna told me about her job, which she enjoys.
mistakes.why: Thông tin phụ về danh từ xác định dùng phẩy + which, không dùng that.

mistakes.wrong: My father, that is a doctor, is retired.
mistakes.right: My father, who is a doctor, is retired.
mistakes.why: Mệnh đề không xác định về người dùng who, không dùng that.

mistakes.wrong: The students, many of who passed, celebrated.
mistakes.right: The students, many of whom passed, celebrated.
mistakes.why: Sau giới từ/lượng từ dùng whom, không dùng who.

mistakes.wrong: The house in that I live is old.
mistakes.right: The house in which I live is old.
mistakes.why: Sau giới từ dùng which, không dùng that.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: Feeling tired, the bed was comfortable.
mistakes.right: Feeling tired, I went to bed.
mistakes.why: Chủ ngữ ngầm của mệnh đề phân từ phải trùng chủ ngữ chính (người mệt là tôi).

mistakes.wrong: The money stealing was never found.
mistakes.right: The money stolen was never found.
mistakes.why: Nghĩa bị động dùng P2 (stolen), không dùng V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: Walked home, I saw an accident.
mistakes.right: Walking home, I saw an accident.
mistakes.why: Hành động chủ động đang diễn ra dùng V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: Having finished the work, the report was submitted.
mistakes.right: Having finished the work, she submitted the report.
mistakes.why: Chủ ngữ sau phải là người thực hiện hành động phân từ.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I like these shoes but not that shoes.
mistakes.right: I like these shoes but not those ones.
mistakes.why: Thay danh từ lặp bằng ones để tránh lặp.

mistakes.wrong: Do you think it will rain? I don't hope so.
mistakes.right: Do you think it will rain? I hope not.
mistakes.why: Phủ định sau hope dùng hope not, không dùng don't hope so.

mistakes.wrong: She can swim and I can swim too.
mistakes.right: She can swim and so can I.
mistakes.why: Tránh lặp bằng so + trợ động từ + chủ ngữ.

mistakes.wrong: He didn't come and I didn't come neither.
mistakes.right: He didn't come and neither did I.
mistakes.why: Phủ định đồng tình dùng neither + trợ động từ + chủ ngữ.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: I suggest that he goes now.
mistakes.right: I suggest that he go now.
mistakes.why: Sau suggest that dùng động từ nguyên thể (go) mọi ngôi.

mistakes.wrong: It is essential that everyone is here.
mistakes.right: It is essential that everyone be here.
mistakes.why: Tính từ cấp thiết + that dùng be, không dùng is.

mistakes.wrong: The doctor insisted that she rests.
mistakes.right: The doctor insisted that she rest.
mistakes.why: Sau insist that dùng dạng gốc động từ, không chia -s.

mistakes.wrong: They demanded that he apologizes.
mistakes.right: They demanded that he apologize.
mistakes.why: Sau demand that dùng động từ nguyên thể.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: He does likes it.
mistakes.right: He does like it.
mistakes.why: Sau does nhấn mạnh, động từ về nguyên thể — không thêm -s.

mistakes.wrong: We did enjoyed the trip.
mistakes.right: We did enjoy the trip.
mistakes.why: Sau did nhấn mạnh, động từ về nguyên thể.

mistakes.wrong: I do wanted to help.
mistakes.right: I did want to help.
mistakes.why: Nhấn mạnh quá khứ dùng did + động từ nguyên thể.

mistakes.wrong: She do love music.
mistakes.right: She does love music.
mistakes.why: Ngôi 3 số ít nhấn mạnh dùng DOES, không dùng do.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: It was you whom invited me.
mistakes.right: It was you who invited me.
mistakes.why: Đại từ làm chủ ngữ mệnh đề sau dùng who, không dùng whom.

mistakes.wrong: It was yesterday when you called.
mistakes.right: It was yesterday that you called.
mistakes.why: Cleft nhấn trạng ngữ thời gian dùng that, không dùng when.

mistakes.wrong: What I need it is a rest.
mistakes.right: What I need is a rest.
mistakes.why: Không lặp tân ngữ (it) trong cấu trúc What... is.

mistakes.wrong: Is the noise that annoys me.
mistakes.right: It is the noise that annoys me.
mistakes.why: Cleft bắt đầu bằng chủ ngữ giả IT.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: Never I have seen such beauty.
mistakes.right: Never have I seen such beauty.
mistakes.why: Trạng ngữ phủ định đầu câu bắt buộc đảo trợ động từ lên trước chủ ngữ.

mistakes.wrong: No sooner we had arrived than it rained.
mistakes.right: No sooner had we arrived than it rained.
mistakes.why: No sooner đầu câu yêu cầu đảo ngữ (had + chủ ngữ).

mistakes.wrong: Not only she sings, but she dances.
mistakes.right: Not only does she sing, but she also dances.
mistakes.why: Not only đầu câu yêu cầu đảo trợ động từ.

mistakes.wrong: Rarely I go out at night.
mistakes.right: Rarely do I go out at night.
mistakes.why: Rarely đầu câu cần đảo ngữ với do/does.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: Although he was tired, but he continued.
mistakes.right: Although he was tired, he continued.
mistakes.why: Không ghép although...but trong một câu.

mistakes.wrong: I like it. However I won't buy it.
mistakes.right: I like it. However, I won't buy it.
mistakes.why: However đầu câu cần dấu phẩy sau nó.

mistakes.wrong: Despite of the rain, we went out.
mistakes.right: Despite the rain, we went out.
mistakes.why: Despite không đi với of (khác in spite OF).

mistakes.wrong: On the other hands, it is cheaper.
mistakes.right: On the other hand, it is cheaper.
mistakes.why: Cụm cố định là on the other HAND (số ít).

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: The government decided to reduce tax. This decide was popular.
mistakes.right: The government decided to reduce tax. This decision was popular.
mistakes.why: Danh hóa động từ decide thành danh từ decision.

mistakes.wrong: I had no trouble to find a place.
mistakes.right: I had no trouble finding a place.
mistakes.why: Have trouble + V-ing.

mistakes.wrong: The analyse of the data took time.
mistakes.right: The analysis of the data took time.
mistakes.why: Danh từ của analyse là analysis.

mistakes.wrong: Her explain was clear.
mistakes.right: Her explanation was clear.
mistakes.why: Danh hóa explain thành explanation.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: This is completely wrong.
mistakes.right: This might not be entirely correct.
mistakes.why: Văn học thuật dùng hedging để mềm hóa nhận định.

mistakes.wrong: If the weather changes, I hope you would remember.
mistakes.right: If the weather changes, I hope you'll remember.
mistakes.why: Hope về khả năng thực tế dùng will, không dùng would.

mistakes.wrong: They would likely to benefit.
mistakes.right: They would likely benefit.
mistakes.why: Likely ở đây là trạng từ — không chèn to trước động từ.

mistakes.wrong: It is obvious true.
mistakes.right: It seems to be true.
mistakes.why: Diễn đạt rào đón dùng seem thay vì khẳng định tuyệt đối.

problems: mistake template — thay bằng cặp câu cụ thể

mistakes.wrong: She is interested about music.
mistakes.right: She is interested in music.
mistakes.why: Interested luôn đi với IN.

mistakes.wrong: It depends of the weather.
mistakes.right: It depends on the weather.
mistakes.why: Depend luôn đi với ON.

mistakes.wrong: I am good in English.
mistakes.right: I am good at English.
mistakes.why: Good luôn đi với AT.

mistakes.wrong: He listened the music.
mistakes.right: He listened to the music.
mistakes.why: Listen luôn đi với TO.
